sideB.text:
INOCULATION UNIT

Put up to 3 Infection cards from the Infection discard pile into Package 6.

You may play this card between step 2 and step 3 of an epidemic.
sideB.footer: Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Drawn while continuing the Legacy deck at Game End step 2 of the first June game, after 06-03. It is a Rationed Event, so it enters the reserve. It is not played when it comes off the Legacy deck.
triggers: Play at any time, including between step 2 and step 3 of an Epidemic.
addsToPool: Rationed Event: Inoculation Unit (this card), to the reserve
rules: Put up to 3 Infection cards from the Infection discard pile into Package 6.
May be played between Epidemic step 2 (Infect) and step 3 (Intensify), so the chosen cards can be removed from the discard before it is shuffled back onto the Infection deck.
Play at any time. Not an action.
Discard after use. It counts toward the rationing-level pick.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the Player-card back and has no printed code. The screen art shows three syringes. Package 6 must already exist for the cards to have somewhere to go; this card does not open it.
